ms.report:
Dear FP,
Thank you for your comprehensive feedback on our Milestone 1 documents. We appreciate your thorough review and have taken your comments into careful consideration to enhance the quality and alignment of our submissions.
Updates to the Detailed Research Report:
We have made substantial updates in line with your suggestions:
・Scalability: Tiamonds currently benefits from Cardano’s cost efficiency and transaction speed, which provide a solid foundation for our current and projected transaction volumes, especially compared to Ethereum. Cardano’s UTXO model offers additional scalability by bundling multiple transactions within a single transaction, enabling more efficient processing without the immediate need for a Layer 2 solution. While we acknowledge that Hydra is not widely utilized at present, its future potential remains promising. As Tiamonds evolves and potentially scales to higher transaction volumes, Hydra could become an integral part of our strategy to handle increased demand seamlessly and maintain optimal performance in a global diamond marketplace.
・Security: We added an assessment of potential vulnerabilities, including an analysis of the independent backend server and potential single points of failure.
・Smart Contract Functionality: We expanded our overview to include Cardano’s deterministic smart contracts, UTXO architecture, and the implications of these features for Tiamonds’ operations.
・Cost Efficiency: We included real-world cost comparisons of fees of different blockchains including Ethereum, BSC, etc.
・Ecosystem and Community Support: We added references to various Cardano community projects and highlighted our ongoing interactions with NMKR and OREMOB.

Updates to the Expansion Strategy Document:
We updated the document to better align with the focus on expanding the Tiamonds marketplace to the Cardano blockchain:
・Updated Context: The document now reflects that Tiamonds is already active on other blockchains and outlines our targeted
